verdict.rationale: There is no dedicated bulk-operations feature in the evidence. Fern Agent can make described changes across a docs repository, such as moving the SDK guides and fixing links, and can run scheduled automations that open PRs. That implies multi-item edits driven by AI. The generated CLIs output JSON so agents can chain calls, and the SDKs include pagination helpers for iterating over many records, but neither is an explicit bulk action. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk-edit or batch-operation capability, documentation of operating on many items in one action, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
